businessSummary: A wedding photographer covering ceremonies and receptions with a natural, documentary style.
audience: Engaged couples planning weddings and looking for a photographer.

reasons.team: A single photographer is the face of the business; a gallery of real wedding photos matters more than a staff roster.

palette.rationale: Soft mauve and cream feel romantic and warm for wedding photography; ink is a gentle brown rather than harsh black.
